name: SP11 Audio GOLDEN v32 — VI+CPS feedback parity
proven_deltas: Enable WSA protection TX clocks only after both WSA8845 PAs are active, matching native Windows ordering.
Use Windows active SoundWire Offset2=0 on feedback master ports 10/11/13.
Enable CPS controller wake/packetization with 0x105c=0x0005000f and DP13 PCM_CTRL 0x1d54=3.

objective_gates.canonical_vi: tap2 8 kHz, native 640-byte payload, nonzero/unique, Windows-range RMS (~12.4–16.6M in repeat tone captures; Windows ~11.73M)
objective_gates.canonical_cps: tap3 24 kHz, native 1920-byte payload, nonzero, ~449–452k RMS; Windows ~455k
objective_gates.pa_faults: 0 through repeated silence/tone lifecycle stress and -12/-6/-3/0 dB 997-Hz staircase
objective_gates.reboot: v32->v31 and v32->v32 normal reboot gates passed

diagnostic_warning: Forced TAP2/TAP3 topology boots are diagnostic-only and can stall ADSP/GLINK teardown at reboot; canonical v32 does not require them.
